description: A reconstruction query keeps projected closes and permits its own witness extras (engine §2.2, §4, and §10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest #·p, late #·_<_Elided>
%elision-only
%rule text $c:c %conditions $c.without-elision-except(fam).parse(w)
%rule c X [+T] | p [+T]
%rule p X
               
%rule w X [+U] [+T]
%rule fam w
